bundle.shortDescription: A notepad whose unsaved tabs survive quitting.
bundle.longDescription: BHNotepad keeps every tab exactly where you left it. Close a tab or quit the app with unsaved scratch notes and it never asks you to save or discard — the text is already on disk, and all of your tabs come back next time. Syntax highlighting, regex find and replace, and no telemetry.
